description: Get the full historical options chain for a ticker on a specific date (2019-2024). Returns every strike + expiration available that day with bid, ask, implied volatility, and all five Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho). Use this for point-in-time backtesting, vol surface snapshots, or single-day analysis. Data source: DoltHub free options dataset, indexed in LiveDataLink's R2 storage.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Coverage: 2019-02-09 to 2024-11-11.

name: options_history_chain
